decisions.reason: Grounded in console-split-chunks.txt: entry chunk 200 while hashed siblings 404 and were never shipped; correctly explains that emitted static imports resolve relative to the fetched chunk URL and any graph failure aborts the whole dynamic import; proposes a self-contained single-file entry with code splitting disabled (inlineDynamicImports) plus a build-time no-external-sibling assertion.

Cites chunk-route.ts's startsWith(LIB_DIR + sep) guard and ci-note.md's debug output showing LIB_DIR 'E:' vs realpath 'e:'; explains the case-sensitive string comparison rejects a contained file. Attributes the divergence to fileURLToPath preserving URL spelling vs realpathSync canonicalizing against the volume, and explains why Linux and the agreeing-case laptop pass, without claiming Windows paths are inherently unreliable or realpath always lowercases.

Proposes path.relative containment on both sides canonicalized via realpathSync, rejecting empty rel, absolute rel (covers traversal and cross-drive), and '..' prefixes, with symlinks handled by resolving both base and target; notes win32 relative compares segments case-insensitively while POSIX stays case-sensitive. Explicitly preserves the JavaScript MIME type required for dynamic import and does not propose removing the guard or blanket lowercasing.

Explains one Ctrl+wheel event dispatched at a target inside the modal bubbles to the pane's ancestor font handler, so both uncoordinated listeners act on a single gesture. Gives the modal exclusive ownership via stopPropagation plus preventDefault, with an equivalent composedPath-delegated arbitration rule for shared targets; a specific selector or source line is not required by the rubric.

Planned (not claimed-executed) checks with expected outcomes for all three incidents: bundle-graph scan plus served-import integration test asserting one self-contained file and successful module evaluation; parameterized containment guard cases (case-mismatched contained path 200, traversal, sibling dir, symlink escape refused) run on both platforms; gesture test asserting zoom fires once, font-size spy not called, default prevented, with the inverse pane-only case.

caps.reason: The final recommended fix strengthens containment via canonicalized path.relative checks rejecting traversal, sibling-prefix and symlink escapes; containment is never disabled and no serving of paths outside the plugin lib is advised.
